name: a comment that names a blocker on an unchanged commit gets an answer, no second review and no spliced text
about: A person commented that a finding still blocked, on a commit nothing had changed since the review. CoderHelm ran a second paid review and posted a reply that spliced the comment into a template. The standing verdict is the answer, in its own whole words.

input.head: a1b2c3d4e5f6
input.comment: This still blocks: the retry loop never ends when the queue is empty.
